$comment: cache-aware-routing catalog — one frontier entry over NVIDIA's inference-api, speaking the
opus-4-8', Authorization: Bearer <INFERENCE_API_KEY>). Updated 2026-09-23 for the M10.1
provider-registry catalog schema: every model now needs a top-level 'providers' entry naming
its base_url, dialect routes, and auth (see examples/catalog.example.json) -- a bare
'provider': 'nvidia' with no 'providers' block, as this file had before, is refused at load.
PRICES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS, not a quote. Replace with real published per-Mtok rates
from openrouter.ai before trusting the dashboard. quality_prior is configuration, not
measurement -- normalize a published intelligence index to 0..1 and record its snapshot date.
cache_model is 'deterministic' (fixed TTL) rather than 'inactivity_decay' because the
anthropic_messages dialect caches only what an explicit cache_control breakpoint names -- see
examples/catalog.example.json's 'anthropic' entry for the same reasoning.
The `model` field is the exact string sent on the wire as 'model'; a wrong id fails the
turn, not the boot. `provider` must match a key under `providers` below.
correlaries is empty because Qwen-Coder-32B/14B and this frontier model are too far apart in
capability for the default capability_band of 0.10. See PLAN.md Phase 3 for how to fix this.
local_quality's 0.72 is a hand-written placeholder (2026-09-23, Option B from INTEGRATION.md
Gap 4 -- the M10.1 import tool supersedes this when it ships), not sourced from a published
index yet; replace before trusting the dashboard's local-side quality claims.
